boundaries.unknown: R1/R2 report fixtures are complete. Explicit None/new value233/renamed aliases/compact split are exercised by a separate real policy test. Episode R4 measures incompleteness separately. Unknown is never replaced by a guessed number.
boundaries.refusal: The injected author approval received an actual institutional-power ValueError whose structured category remains unknown/unclassified_exception; actual runtime status is unattributed_tool_rejection. The known experimental fault choice does not change the tool taxonomy or become an environment-error claim.
boundaries.controller: Controller only installs declared fixtures and measures. It never passes findings, fixed report body, evaluator results, or expected truth into policy contexts. v0.9 controlled baseline is a separate actual execution, not a replay substituted for runtime actions.
boundaries.strategies: Finite program policies on synthetic existing templates; no model/API/GPU/training. Reconciliation reviewer reuses the worker matcher, so independent literal truths remain necessary against correlated mistakes.
